connection.notes: Development: updated automatically by make run with the pty slave path. Production: set to the real instrument port (e.g. /dev/ttyUSB0).

sensors.name: Engine RPM
sensors.notes: Marine diesel rated at 1800 RPM. Source: ISO 8665.

sensors.name: Coolant Temperature
sensors.notes: Normal operating range 70-90C. Source: engine manufacturer datasheet.

sensors.name: Fuel Pressure
sensors.notes: Marine injection pressure 3-8 bar. Source: engine manufacturer datasheet.

sensors.name: Hull Vibration
sensors.notes: ISO 6954:2000 — comfort limit 6 mm/s, structural inspection above 12 mm/s.

sensors.name: Wind Speed
sensors.notes: Beaufort 6 (12 m/s) = warning. Beaufort 8 (18 m/s) = critical.

sensors.name: Wind Direction
sensors.notes: Directional data only — no alarm thresholds.

sensors.name: Water Depth
sensors.notes: Conservative values for a 1.8m draft vessel.

sensors.name: Propeller Torque
sensors.notes: Expressed as % of rated torque. Source: propulsion system datasheet.

sensors.name: Engine Oil Pressure
sensors.notes: Engine oil pressure. Normal range 2-5 bar. Source: engine manufacturer datasheet. NOTE: no simulator data — channel will show no updates until a real instrument is connected.
